aiDemo.title: Conversational Agricultural Advisory
aiDemo.subtitle: Experience how farmers can interact in natural language to diagnose symptoms, plan crop schedules, and receive verified agronomic recommendations.
aiDemo.disclaimer: Demonstration Preview: Illustrates conversational advisory format. Production diagnosis requires image uploads and multi-spectral validation.
aiDemo.userPrompt: My tomato leaves are turning yellow with brown spots around the edges. What should I do?
aiDemo.aiResponse:
Based on the symptoms of yellowing leaves with necrotic margins on tomato plants, this is likely Early Blight (Alternaria solani) or nutrient deficiency (Nitrogen or Potassium). Immediate steps:
1. Isolate and prune lower affected foliage to stop spore splash.
2. Ensure drip lines do not splash soil onto stems.
3. Apply Mancozeb 75% WP (2g/L) or Copper Oxychloride if fungal signs persist.
4. Consult local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) for soil nitrate testing.
aiDemo.actionAdvice: Generated via AgroCloud Crop Diagnostics Protocol v1.4
